item.title: elogee asked me for a note and mine couldnt fit in the collapsible
item.content:encoded:
+ show block
– hide block

it's funny: i can remember doing these forever, but this is only my third time. each time, I feel like I've run out of things to say. horror's just a gimmick, after all. genre fiction, don't they call it? cheap twists, promises of blood. "the benign thing was scary all along." "it's breeding under the floorboards." "they were alive this whole time." "the Foundation DID do the forbidden test!!!"

Gears (you, and many others too: Bright, Clef, the rest of the old guard I can't recall): you started something, you put something out into the world, and we kept coming back for it. despite how much I complain about how things change, despite the sparkle and kitsch of the new: we keep coming back. each time I come back I notice in all the little ways I've grown or changed, and all the tendencies of me I'd rather have left behind. I cringe at the old tropes and balk at the new things, and despite all of that, I keep coming back.

maybe it's something about the first things that stuck around, when we wrote that first thousand. maybe there's something in the water…

thank you, Gears, for the work you've done. thank you, for making something worth remembering, for making something worth coming back to. there has been so much growth here, and there has (I still want to believe) so much we have yet to discover about the old things. here's to a good many years more. <3

item.title: Re: Gears Day! It has arrived.
item.content:encoded:
“What is this?.”

This is Gears Day - an excuse for us to write creepypasta as a birthday gift for the one and only Dr Gears.

“How do I add my own?”

Well, like this, Mystery Editor.

Toss in a collapsible. Give us the name of your creepy pasta and your name as the "show", and put in a special birthday message as the "hide." Make sure you put in a line break.

Have fun, guys. And enjoy Gears Day!

item.title: Gears Day! It has arrived.
item.content:encoded:
It's the first day of the Halloween season, Gears Day! Annual Foundation creepypasta holiday, a celebration of Gears' Birthday and an open collection just for him. Well, and everyone else who wants to read.

As per tradition, feel free to write your own and add them to this page!

Have a great one, Gears. You deserve it this year, too. If anybody does, it's you.
